method: Three alternating before/after source pairs per mode and host; same candidate runtime on both sides, fresh processes, Node v24.15.0. Monitor foreign Node processes before and every second during execution. Intel >=98% idle and zero swap activity immediately before every run. No samples removed from the final series. Execution includes parse/analysis; process startup excluded. Peak RSS covers the process lifetime.
limitations: Historical issue timings are not the fresh baseline.
Micro-controls run warmed in one process; milliseconds, not a claim of statistical equivalence.
Final metadata-only Int32 width-guard placement was checked by 39 focused tests per host after the timing series.
